note: Offline request list derived deterministically from the adopted YouTube Apify CSV declaration (6 runs). No live/ external API was called. Values marked pending are transcribed verbatim from the declaration and still await cloud corroboration; values marked missing are absent everywhere and must be obtained later by the owner. Nothing here promotes collector capabilities.

required_fields.description: Apify actor run ID that produced the dataset export.
required_fields.obtain_via: Apify Console Runs list or runs API (owner action); corroborate the transcribed value and capture the run URL and access timestamp as evidence_source.

required_fields.description: Apify dataset ID holding the run output items.
required_fields.obtain_via: Apify Console dataset view or datasets API (owner action); corroborate the transcribed value and capture the dataset URL and access timestamp as evidence_source.

required_fields.description: Full actor input JSON for the run (search query, maxResults, dateFilter, proxy, language and other parameters).
required_fields.obtain_via: Apify Console run detail input tab or runs API input endpoint (owner action). Never reconstructed from the CSV payload.

required_fields.description: Run start timestamp (UTC) as recorded by Apify.
required_fields.obtain_via: Apify Console Runs list or runs API (owner action); corroborate the transcribed value.

required_fields.description: Run finish timestamp (UTC) as recorded by Apify.
required_fields.obtain_via: Apify Console Runs list or runs API (owner action); corroborate the transcribed value.

required_fields.description: Terminal run status as recorded by Apify (e.g. SUCCEEDED).
required_fields.obtain_via: Apify Console Runs list or runs API (owner action); corroborate the transcribed value.

required_fields.description: Where the cloud evidence was observed (console URL, API endpoint, export filename) and when, so a later evidence-registry entry can cite it.
required_fields.obtain_via: Recorded by the owner at retrieval time (URL + accessed_at + method). Left missing until retrieval happens.

status_vocabulary.pending: Value transcribed from the declaration; cloud corroboration and evidence-registry registration are still outstanding.
status_vocabulary.missing: No value exists anywhere in the repository; retrieval is required. The value stays null until then.
status_vocabulary.observed: Reserved for the future closed state: value corroborated against cloud evidence and registered. Not used in this revision.
